data.title: bn-2ri63: CML pinned-init lowering path (RFC 0003 c6); claim A with a counted atomic crash

data.body:
[LOW][CWE-770][risk:high] Preallocate the filtered axis before copying pin values

The charge at lines 201-211 reserves two logical copies per pinning leaf. One copy is `scratch`, whose capacity is fixed at `leaves`. The second copy is built here through `filter(...).collect::<Vec<i64>>()`. `Filter` is not an exact-size iterator. `Vec` may therefore grow geometrically and retain capacity above its element count. A large disjunction of in-domain pins can allocate backing storage beyond the prepaid output bound while `Usage.nodes` reports only the retained values. This violates the crate's strict charge-before-allocation contract for untrusted CML.

Failure modes: An adversarial init predicate can make the pinned analysis exceed its declared memory envelope before any typed resource refusal. Concurrent lowerings amplify the unreported allocation.

Edge cases: One axis with many distinct in-domain leaves maximizes growth. Just-over-power-of-two lengths expose excess capacity. Filtered-out and duplicate values reduce retained length. The leaf, variable, and node limits keep the excess bounded, so severity is LOW.

Rollback: Keep `InitPath::Pinned` unavailable until each values buffer has a capacity bounded by the existing precharge. A direct repair is `Vec::with_capacity(scratch.len())` followed by `extend` of the filtered values.

Monitoring: Record pin-leaf count, axis length and capacity, `Usage.nodes`, peak allocation, and concurrent pinned lowerings. Treat capacity beyond the charged leaf bound as a contract violation.

Validation: Add large disjunctions with sizes around allocation growth boundaries. Prove exact-limit replay, one-node-short refusal before allocation, capacity no larger than the prepaid leaf bound, and model equality with whole-domain enumeration.

The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains mandatory. This static review cannot waive it.

[LOW][evidence] Tighten the differential oracle when the enumerate path reaches a resource limit

This arm accepts every pinned result when the whole-domain oracle returns a resource refusal. It therefore treats a pinned Evaluation, UndefinedRead, NoInitialStates, or unrelated resource error as `Relaxed`. The corpus and configured-example loops can miss a pinned-path regression on cases whose oracle cannot complete. Require pinned success, or explicitly limit the accepted alternative to the intended resource class.

Counterevidence: generated cases require exact agreement. Explicit boundary and counted-crash tests require pinned success. The main 184,512-state evidence also checks closure, invariants, steps, and a seeded crash defect. This is an evidence-quality gap, not a production-path blocker by itself.

data.reason: Unresolved LOW CWE-770 resource-accounting defect: the pinned-axis Filter collect can allocate Vec capacity beyond the prepaid leaf bound at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/lower/pinned.rs:201-239. A separate LOW differential-oracle gap is recorded at tests/init_pinned.rs:73-82. The risk:critical human gate remains separate.

data.body:
[RESOLVED][LOW][CWE-770][risk:high] Re-review at 04f5a4d820db2e00c30784205b79b0a18c29c369 confirms the repair at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/lower/pinned.rs:259-306. The pin table, scratch buffer, axis buffers, axes, cursor, and candidate vector now receive fixed capacities after precharge. The trace records charged and held capacity for boundary checks.

Failure modes: The prior geometric growth path is removed. Remaining budget exhaustion returns a typed resource refusal before these allocations.

Edge cases: Tests cover power-of-two boundaries, filtered values, duplicates, empty axes, exact-limit replay, and a one-node-short refusal.

Rollback: Disable InitPath::Pinned and use InitPath::Enumerate if capacity or equivalence checks regress.

Monitoring: Compare held_values with charged_values and held_entries with charged_entries. Track typed resource refusals and differential mismatches.

Validation: Static review checked the allocation and charge order. Committed tests exercise capacities from 63 through 1025 leaves. This session did not run tests because it may write only Seal metadata.

The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains mandatory.

[RESOLVED][LOW][evidence] Re-review at 04f5a4d820db2e00c30784205b79b0a18c29c369 confirms the repair at crates/continuum-cml-elab/tests/init_pinned.rs:75-84. Relaxation now requires an oracle resource refusal and a successful pinned result. Any different pinned error reaches the panic arm. Corpus and configured-example checks can no longer mask those regressions.
